title: AdaptKit interaction event (v0.1)
description: One row = one target selection (a trial). The same format is used for every data layer: converted secondary data, the tap test, usability-test logs and simulated data. Stored as CSV (one column per property) or JSON lines. Never contains typed text or names.

source.description: Which data layer the row comes from

is_synthetic.description: 1 = made by a simulator or a test fixture, never a real person

participant.description: Anonymous participant code, unique within the source (e.g. 'F246', 'T017')

session.description: One continuous sitting with one device (Findlater: ExperimentId)

condition.description: Study condition; null when not part of the comparison

trial.description: Order of the selection within the session, starting at 0

target_w.description: Target size in CSS px (smaller side for non-square targets)

amplitude.description: Distance in CSS px from the previous selection (or start area) to the target centre

hit.description: 1 = first press landed on the target; 0 = at least one miss before success

time_ms.description: Movement time: from start (previous selection / start area) to the successful selection

misses.description: Number of presses that missed before success

miss_dist_px.description: Distance of the first miss from the nearest target edge

hesitation_ms.description: Time from start until the pointer first moves

zoom.description: 1 = a pinch-zoom or browser zoom happened during the selection

ui_target_level.description: Index into policy.levels.target_px at the time of the selection

policy_action.description: Action applied right after this selection (after the safety shield), or null

undo.description: 1 = the user pressed Undo on an adaptation notice after this selection

outlier.description: 1 = flagged as an outlier by the source or by cleaning; excluded from analysis

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 time of the selection (null for converted data)
